nodes.label: SINAMICS G120 CU240B/E-2 Control Units List Manual (LH11) 01/2012
nodes.author: Siemens AG

nodes.label: Faults (F) vs alarms (A): faults need cause removal + acknowledge; alarms self-reset
Fault buffer r0945/r0947/r0949, alarm buffer r2110/r2122
Fault acknowledgement (POWER ON / IMMEDIATELY via p3981, STW1.7)
Safety Integrated (STO, SS1, SLS, SDI, SSM)
F01600 SI P1: STOP A initiated
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Select STO and deselect again; for value 9999 diagnose F01611

nodes.label: F01611 SI P1: Defect in a monitoring channel (crosswise data comparison)
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check cross-compared data (r9795); acknowledge

nodes.label: N01620 SI P1: Safe Torque Off active
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Not necessary

nodes.label: A01009 CU: Control module overtemperature
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check air intake and Control Unit fan

nodes.label: A01590 Motor maintenance interval expired
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Carry out maintenance and reset interval p0651

nodes.label: F01910 Fieldbus interface setpoint timeout
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Re-establish bus connection, switch on peer, set PROFIBUS master to RUN, adapt p2040

nodes.label: F08501 PROFINET: Setpoint timeout
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Restore bus connection, set controller to RUN, check monitoring time

nodes.label: F03505 CU: Analog input wire breakage
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check connection to signal source; check injected current r0752

nodes.label: A05000 Power unit: Overtemperature heat sink (alarm)
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check ambient temperature, load duty cycle, cooling

nodes.label: F30004 Power unit: Overtemperature heat sink AC inverter
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check fan running, fan elements, ambient temperature, motor load; reduce pulse frequency

nodes.label: F07011 Drive: Motor overtemperature
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Reduce motor load, check ambient temperature and sensor (KTY/PTC)

nodes.label: A07910 Drive: Motor overtemperature (alarm)
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check motor load, ambient temperature, sensor

nodes.label: A07015 Motor temperature sensor alarm
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check sensor connection and p0601

nodes.label: F07016 Motor temperature sensor fault
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check sensor connection and p0601

nodes.label: F07801 Drive: Motor overcurrent
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check current limits p0640, current controller, ramp-up time, motor cable

nodes.label: F30001 Power unit: Overcurrent
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check control parameters, motor/cables for short-circuit/ground fault, ramp-up, line reactor

nodes.label: F30002 Power unit: DC link overvoltage
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Increase ramp-down time p1121, rounding times, activate Vdc controller

nodes.label: F30003 Power unit: DC link undervoltage
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check line supply voltage and phases (p0210)

nodes.label: A07400 DC link voltage maximum controller active
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Ramp-down time automatically extended

nodes.label: F30005 Power unit: Overload I2t
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Reduce continuous load, adapt duty cycle, check rated currents, reduce p0640

nodes.label: A07805 Drive: Power unit overload I2t (alarm)
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Reduce continuous load, adapt duty cycle

nodes.label: F30011 Power unit: Line phase failure in main circuit
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check main circuit fuses, single-phase loads, motor feeder cables

nodes.label: A30057 Power unit: Line asymmetry
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check line phase connection and motor feeder cables

nodes.label: F30015 Power unit: Phase failure motor cable
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check motor feeder cables, ramp times

nodes.label: F30017 Hardware current limit responded too often
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check motor data, star-delta, load, power cables

nodes.label: F30021 Power unit: Ground fault
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check power cables, motor, CT, brake cables

nodes.label: F07807 Short-circuit/ground fault detected
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check phase-phase short circuit, interchanged line/motor cables, ground fault

nodes.label: F07900 Drive: Motor blocked
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check motor can move freely, check torque limit

nodes.label: F07902 Drive: Motor stalled
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Perform motor data identification/rotating measurement, increase p1610

nodes.label: F07901 Drive: Motor overspeed
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check r1084, correct p1082/p2162

nodes.label: F07936 Drive: Load failure
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check sensor; deactivate load monitoring p2193 if needed

nodes.label: F07410 Current controller output limited
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Connect motor/check contactor, star-delta, DC link voltage, power unit, flying restart

nodes.label: F07802 Infeed or power unit not ready
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Increase p0857, ensure DC link voltage, check p0210

nodes.label: F30027 Precharging DC link time monitoring
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check line voltage, line contactor, precharge resistors, DC link short

nodes.label: F30035 Power unit: Air intake overtemperature (55 C)
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check fan and ambient temperature

nodes.label: F30036 Power unit: Internal overtemperature
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check fan and ambient temperature

nodes.label: A30042 Fan operating time reached
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Replace fan, reset p0251

nodes.label: A30049 Internal fan faulty (alarm)
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check/replace internal fan

nodes.label: F30059 Power unit: Internal fan faulty
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check/replace internal fan

nodes.label: F30055 Braking chopper overcurrent
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Check braking resistor for short circuit or undersizing

nodes.label: F07320 Automatic restart interrupted
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Increase restart attempts p1211 / monitoring time

nodes.label: F07860 External fault 1 (BICO p2106)
nodes.rationale: Remedy: Eliminate the external cause

nodes.label: Ground fault / short-circuit in motor or power cables
Line phase failure / supply voltage problem

hyperedges.label: Heat sink overtemperature escalation (fan failure -> A05000 -> F30004)
Safety Integrated stop chain (F01611 -> F01600 STOP A -> STO)
